entries.zh: 赤砂糖（原糖熬制未精炼之粗糖）；漏尾糖（糖浆流尾凝结之渣糖）
entries.en: chancaca: crude unrefined loaf sugar made from the last run of molasses

entries.zh: 糖螺（呈螺旋状缠卷之粗糖，糖膏绕棒凝结成螺旋形）
entries.en: chancaca mascacida: sugar wound in a spiral coil (lit. 'sugar snail')
entries.notes: 汉栏'糖螺'与西语 mascacida 对应关系属推断，mascacida 或为 chewed/worked sugar 之形状描述。

entries.en: imperial edict (chʻi), decree issued by the emperor

entries.zh: 文引（官府签发的通行、贸易凭引，Sangley 出入港之执照）
entries.en: travel and trade permit / license document (wên-yin) required of Chinese residents and merchants

entries.zh: 给文引（颁发文引，官府发放通行执照）
公文（官府公文，官员签发之文书）
entries.en: official document dispatched by the mandarin; government dispatch

entries.zh: 劄付（王府或官府下行之劄付文书，此处指国王敕札）
entries.en: royal diploma / official warrant (cha-fu), document from the king
lacquer; varnish (raw lacquer from the lacquer tree)

entries.zh: 佞（巧言善辩之人，花言巧语者）〔原件字形存疑：佞/倿〕
entries.en: charlatan; smooth talker, glib flatterer (q. hablador)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:佞/倿]，字形待定；佞 'glib/flattering' 最贴合 Charlatan q. hablador。

entries.zh: 烟筒（烟囱、烟道管）〔原件字形存疑：捅/筒〕
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语词头 'Ché gueray poroña' 语义不明，汉字与注音栏均空）
entries.en: 〔manuscript defective: Spanish headword 'Ché gueray poroña' of unclear meaning, Chinese and phonetic columns blank〕

entries.zh: 唐（指中国；华人自称唐人）
entries.en: China (as Chinese call their own country: Tng)

entries.zh: 唐山（中国人对故国中国之称呼）
entries.en: T'ang-shan: China proper, the Chinese homeland (as called by the Chinese)

entries.zh: 中国（中华帝国，大明王朝之国）
entries.en: Chung-kuo: the Middle Kingdom, i.e. China; the kingdom thereof

entries.zh: 大明国（明朝中国之国号）
entries.en: Ta Ming kuo: the Empire of the Great Ming (China under the Ming dynasty)
